en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style view over a historic European town built on and below a wooded hillside. On the left stands a large medieval hilltop castle with a prominent round tower and battlements, partly hidden by trees. Below and to the right stretches a dense cluster of steep‑roofed houses and narrow streets. Dominating the right side of the image is a large Gothic church with a tall spire and pointed-arch windows. The skyline includes additional church towers and old civic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the front.
